device_path.description: The path to the TTY device

port.description: Identifier of physical port device_path is mapped to

min_delay.description: The minimum idle time of the bus between transactions in milli-seconds

health_check_interval.description: Seconds between checks that close the device once its path is gone and reopen it once it is back. Defaults to 600

debug.description: Enables device tracing and potentially other debug prints

ignored_addrs.description: (debug) ignore certain addresses on this interface
